options.POS_STAFF_APK_ENABLED: false by default; true requires all approved package fields
options.POS_STAFF_APK_PATH: absolute private regular .apk source file path; no symlink leaf; never published as static media
options.POS_CUSTOMER_APP_MODE: disabled (default), explicitly approved fallback, or verified provider
options.POS_CUSTOMER_APP_LINK_ENDPOINT: exact HTTPS provider POST endpoint, without credentials/query/fragment
options.POS_CUSTOMER_APP_ORIGINS: exact comma-separated HTTPS destination origins; default https://www.thesouledstore.com
options.POS_CUSTOMER_APP_WEBSITE: source long-link website HTTPS origin; default https://www.thesouledstore.com
options.POS_APP_REDIRECT: source fallback destination, explicitly constrained to approved origins and safe source query keys

artifact_contract: Operator has approved the exact existing staff APK, its publisher/signature, hash and byte count. This project creates no mobile application.
Mount the approved source file read-only. APP_APK_URL is not fetched automatically; the rewrite deliberately does not proxy arbitrary remote binary content.
First preparation verifies regular file, exact byte count, ZIP/APK header and full SHA256 while staging one private 0400 snapshot in a 0700 temporary directory.

Snapshots are streamed only after a current writer-authorized download claim. Already-aborted requests do not create a readable stream. Closing the application removes only its own temporary snapshot.
A code grants one activation operation and one download operation; the identical operation may retry the same bytes until activation expiry. A different consumer is rejected atomically.
Bind the grant to current operator authentication epoch and exact artifact metadata. Account disable/restore cannot revive old grants.
Signature/package compatibility is an artifact-release acceptance requirement; a ZIP header is not proof of publisher authenticity.

customer_provider_contract.request: POST configured endpoint, JSON {link:'https://www.thesouledstore.com?store_id=<exact signed INT>'} using configured website origin
customer_provider_contract.idempotency: Idempotency-Key UUID remains stable across retries of one persisted cache-generation operation. Verify upstream support before enabling provider mode.
customer_provider_contract.response: JSON object.shortLink optional; missing/null/empty uses explicitly approved POS_APP_REDIRECT. Malformed, unapproved, oversized, redirected and non-2xx responses fail closed.
customer_provider_contract.bounds: 10-second request, no redirects/cookies, streaming32KiB JSON limit, exact approved HTTPS destination origins. Only public store_id and app package id query keys are permitted.
customer_provider_contract.cache: One-hour SQL cache keyed by store, fenced30-second lease and durable provider-operation ID. No silent shared-Redis authority; mixed rollout requires explicit cache transition acceptance.
customer_provider_contract.scan_audit: Atomically insert one source pos_to_app_logs(store_id,scanned_at) plus a receipt per scan operation. Keep source defaults for created_at/updated_at. Failure to write the audit never produces a successful redirect.
customer_provider_contract.store_scope: Issuing uses actual current SQL check-in, writer-current role/organization/assignment and active store. Every redemption rechecks active store before and after provider I/O.
customer_provider_contract.physical_int_boundary: Verified pos_to_app_logs.store_id and id are signed INT; reject unsupported store IDs explicitly without Number rounding.
customer_provider_contract.deprecation: Google documents Firebase Dynamic Links shutdown on2025-08-25. Do not assume the old company firebase-dynamic-link endpoint is an accepted current provider; verify its actual replacement and deep-link behavior.

storage_and_trace.prune: pruneApplicationLinks(db,now=Date.now()) deletes at most100 expired staff proofs and100 scan receipts older than24hours per call. Keep source scan logs and printable store links.
storage_and_trace.logging: Root static module/resource/action events with request/user IDs; no URL/query/body/cookie/token/contact/raw error logging. Proof digests, opaque operation IDs, issuer/store IDs and safe initiating request IDs are persisted.
storage_and_trace.public_authority: Anonymous possession-proof requests omit cookies and send the capability only in a strict same-origin POST body. No session is created or borrowed. Anonymous scanner identity remains unknown.

intentional_source_corrections: Self-only staff issuance replaces arbitrary posted operator selectors.
Opaque purpose-bound capabilities replace source contact-bearing JWT query parameters and verification-disabled JWT decoding.
Atomic per-operator grants replace non-atomic TOTP rotation and email-prefix activation keys.
Explicit click-to-open/download and POST redemption replace GET mutations, unvalidated redirects and hidden-iframe download.
A successful scan/redirect requires a committed idempotent source audit, rather than counting a failed provider attempt.
Verified immutable local package streaming replaces unbounded arbitrary remote response buffering.
remaining_acceptance: Approved actual APK path/hash/size/publisher signature and configured real download on supported browsers/devices.
Verified current customer deep-link provider or approved fallback, idempotency behavior, exact destination origins and existing-app/store attribution.
Explicit migration/retirement of previously printed unsigned /user_to_app?store_id= links; no unsafe automatic legacy-token alias is enabled.
Configured web/Electron handoff and OS-browser acceptance through root POS_APP_LINK_ORIGINS.
Actual operational writer/source timezone and complete source/rewrite workflow parity. No whole source route is certified.
